body: This all could be simpler but it can be tackled in a separate refactoring PR.
Could there be a race condition here where reverting to the `userToken` would be overridden by an undefined `authenticatedUserToken`?
you mentioned the refactor, but I'm not sure if it's a good idea to have two adjacent optional params. Shouldn't the first userToken be required (but allowed to be undefined)?
The internal `setUserTokenToSearch` function returns if the passed `userToken` is falsy (once normalized) so this shouldn't happen. Is this what you had in mind?
Isn't it the same? If not passed, the `userToken ` will be `undefined`.

Yes, but there's no real use case for passing `authenticatedUserToken` if `userToken` isn't passed (you can't do it). If the signature is required (maybe even for both) we won't have weird edge cases if ever we call setUserToken without parameters
Yep I think I see what you mean. This function is meant to be internal (and temporary) just to avoid repetition and further inflating bundle size. I can rewrite it more cleanly later.
